## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-fascicle *bhikṣu-prātimokṣa* with embedded interlinear annotations by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)). 含注 *hánzhù* "embedded annotations" indicates the format — the parent *prātimokṣa* text is presented in full with explanatory notes inserted directly within the rule-text rather than as separate commentary.

**Abstract**

The *Hánzhù jièběn* is the third of the **Three Great Works of the Nánshān school** (along with [KR6k0046](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0046) *Suíjī jiémó* and [KR6k0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0128) *Xíngshì chāo*). After the imperial canonisation of the *Sìfēn lǜ* in 709 CE, this work became the universal **Sìfēn *prātimokṣa* recitation-text with commentary** for monastic instruction throughout East Asian Buddhism. Its embedded-gloss format proved especially effective for teaching new monks the practical meaning and application of each rule — making it the standard pedagogical text for the *Sìfēn* tradition.
